description.value:
Requirements You're in Bladework Stance.

With a little more concentration, your blades stay deadly even when returning to you. Recall all blades within your Favored Blade's first range increment. Draw a line between you and the starting position of each blade. Any creature inside them takes damage equal to your Favored Blade's damage dice with a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] save against your soaring blade DC.

The damage type is the same as your Favored Blade. An enemy can only take this damage once, even if inside the path of two or more blades.
